## Nuvio Unmodified 0.4.11

Unmodified build of the NuvioMedia source (`cmp-rewrite`). Not affiliated with or endorsed by NuvioMedia.

### Changelog
- feat(details): add tappable expandable descriptions @tapframe
- fallback CJK cast names and filmography titles to English/Romaji @halibiram
- Port NuvioTV fixes: YouTube extractor, trailer language, scrobble guard, aggregate credits @skoruppa
- fix: Simkl anime type classification and landscape poster aspect ratio @skoruppa
- fix(details): reset episode position when switching seasons @tapframe
- fix(search): persist discover catalog selection @tapframe
- fix(ios): correct launch screen configuration @tapframe
- fix(player): make subtitle aggregation multiplatform @tapframe
- Respect corner radius for trailers and episodes @skoruppa
- i18n(el): add missing Greek translations @nosvasedis
- fix(catalog): preserve scroll position after details @tapframe
- fix: address mobile crash clusters @tapframe
- Latest strings added to the Bulgarian translation @viiktr
- fix: per-episode rating from addon metadata is never parsed @6ip
- feat(player): port sidecar addon subtitles, fix selection state, and parallelize fetching @halibiram

> **Note:** SIMKL integration is now working. Trakt is still pending — I'm missing the API credentials needed to register a client (it now requires a paid VIP membership). Working on getting this fixed.
